title: The Emerald Velvet Christmas Party Outfit
description: Emerald Velvet Christmas Party Outfit: Simplee velvet long sleeve mini dress, Allegra K glitter ankle strap block heels, Chunky gold petal statement earrings, Pearl beaded evening clutch.
intro: Every December I panic about one party and end up in the same black dress. Not this year. An emerald velvet mini, pink glitter block heels, gold petal earrings, a hot pink pearl clutch, sparkle tights and a faux fur wrap for the walk from the car. It looks like I tried really hard, and I absolutely did not.

sections.heading: The dress
paragraphs: A green velvet long sleeve mini dress with a ruffle hem. Velvet does all the work, so everything else just has to sparkle.

sections.heading: Shoes, tights and earrings
paragraphs: Pink glitter ankle strap block heels with a comfy heel, sheer sparkle tights, and chunky gold petal statement earrings.

sections.heading: For the walk in
paragraphs: A hot pink pearl beaded evening clutch and an ivory faux fur shawl wrap.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The rooms, props and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
